spans.s:
शय a. (या, --यी f.) [शी-अच्]
Lying down, sleeping (usually at
the end of comp.); रात्रिजागरपरो
दिवाशयः

; so उत्तानशय,
पार्श्वशय, वृक्षेशय, बिलेशय &c.
--यः
1
Sleep.
--2 A bed, couch.
--3 A
hand.
--4 A snake, especially the
boa.
--5 Abuse, imprecation, curse.
--6 A stake.

शय्या [शी-आधारे क्यप्]
1 A bed,
couch; शय्या भूमितलं Śānti. 4. 9;
मही रम्या शय्या

.
--2 Sleeping.
--3 Tying, stringing
together.
--Comp.
--अध्यक्षः, --पालः,
the superintendent or guardian of
a king's bed-chamber.
--उत्संगः the
side of a bed.
--गत a. {1} lying in
[]
a bed. {2} confined to a bed.
--गृहं
a bed-chamber;
शयंड a. Sleepy, sleeping.

शयथ a. [शी-अथच्] Sleepy,
asleep.
--थः
1 Death.
--2 A kind of
snake, the boa-constrictor.
--3 A
boar.
--4 A fish.

शयनं [शी-ल्युट्]
1 Sleeping, sleep,
lying down.
--2 A bed, couch;
शयनस्थो न भुंजीत

.
--3 Copulation, sexual
union.
--Comp.
--अ (आ) गारः --रं,
--गृहं a bed-chamber, sleeping
apartments.
--एकादशी the eleventh day
of the bright half of Āṣāḍha when
Viṣṇu lies down to enjoy his four
months’ repose.
--सखी a bed-fellow.
--स्थानं a sleeping apartment,
bedchamber.

सायनं The longitude of a planet
reckoned from the vernal equinoctial
point.

शयनीयं [शी-आधरे अनीयर्] A bed,
couch; परिशून्यं शयनीयमद्य मे

;
कांतासखस्य शयनीयशिलातलं ते
; (शयनीयकं in the same sense).

1 A chameleon.
--2 A
kind of snake, the boa.

शयालु a. [शी-आलुच्] Sleepy,
slothful; हंति नोपशयस्थोपि
शयालुर्मृगयुर्मृगान् Śi. 2. 80.
--लुः
1 A kind
of snake, the boa-constrictor.
--2
A dog.
--3 A jackal.

शयित p. p. [शी-कर्तरि क्त]
1
Sleeping, reposed, asleep.
--2 Lying down.
--तं Sleep, sleeping.

शयुः, शयुनः A large snake, the
boa.

शयुः, शयुनः A large snake, the
boa.
शायः Lying, sleeping.

सायः [सो-घञ्]
1 End, close,
termination.
--2 Close of day, evening.
--3
An arrow. (साये ‘in the evening,
at the close of the day.)
--Comp.
--अहन् m. (forming सायाह्नः) evening,
evening time;
शायिका Repose, sleep.

शायिन् a. Reclining, sleeping,
resting &c.
सायिन् m. A horseman.

सायकः [सो-ण्वुल्]
1 An arrow;
तत्साधुकृतसंधानं प्रतिसंहर सायकं
Ś. 1. 11.
--2 A sword.
--Comp.
--पुंखः
the feathered part of an arrow;
सक्तांगुलिः सायकपुंख एव
सय् {c1c} A. (सयते) To go, move.

सयूथ्यः One of the same flock
or tribe.

सयोनि a.
1 Having the same
womb, uterine.
--2 Closely related
to.
--3 Closely united with the
womb.
--निः
1 A whole or uterine
brother.
--2 A pair of nippers for
cutting betel-nut.
--3 N. of Indra.

सायंतन a. (नी f.) Belonging
to the evening, evening; सायंतने
सवनकर्मणि संप्रवृत्ते Ś. 3. 27;
अलिनारमतालिनी शिलींध्रे सह
सायंतनदीपपादलाभे Śi. 6. 72.

सायम् ind. In the evening; प्रयता
प्रातरन्वेतु सायं प्रत्युद्व्रजेदपि

.
--Comp.
--कालः evening.
--धृतिः f.
the evening oblation.
--मंडनं {1}
sunset. {2} the sun.
--संध्या {1} the
evening twilight. {2} the evening
prayer. {3} the goddess to be
worshipped in the evening. ˚देवता N. of
Sarasvatī.

सायणः N. of a very learned
Brāhmaṇa supposed to have
flourished about 1370 A. D.

1 Intimate union,
identification, absorption, especially into
a deity (one of the four states of
Mukti).
--2 Similarity, likeness.
